authority_note: Additive review artifact for the 15 P2 SCREEN_IN names. Scores cover the first six business-quality categories only. Valuation, final veto status, total score and latest-pointer promotion remain unresolved until the remaining harness stages are complete.

evidence: Q2 2026 consolidated revenue KRW639.5bn +10.4% and operating profit KRW66.9bn +34.1%, both quarterly records.
Leclaza royalty/licensing economics and internally developed pipeline add upside beyond mature domestic pharma distribution.
counter_evidence: Royalty/licensing timing is lumpy and core domestic pharma growth is less structurally differentiated than platform biotech.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW5.5272tn +40.5% and operating profit KRW245.8bn versus KRW11.4bn a year earlier; H1 revenue exceeded KRW11tn.
High-end camera modules, RF-SiP/FC-CSP/FC-BGA and automotive modules are broadening the product mix.
counter_evidence: Optical-solutions economics remain highly dependent on a major North American smartphone customer and product-cycle timing; recent profit recovery follows an unusually weak comparator.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW467.2bn +29.3%, operating profit KRW131.1bn +116.9%, net profit KRW84.1bn +95.5%.
R&D investment of KRW60.3bn in Q2 and multiple metabolic/oncology programs create reinvestment optionality while core profitability is strong.
counter_evidence: Pipeline outcomes are binary and partner/licensing economics can be lumpy; R&D productivity must be measured over multi-year cohorts.

evidence: ADC platform has generated global licensing relationships and an Ono LCB97 milestone in 2026.
FY2025 revenue KRW141.6bn demonstrates monetization capacity beyond a pre-revenue platform.
counter_evidence: H1 2026 operating loss was about KRW118.6bn as R&D surged; Q2 standalone revenue fell sharply and pipeline cash flows are milestone-dependent.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW861.3bn +17.8%, operating profit KRW110.3bn +50.2%, net profit KRW70.6bn +68.9%.
K-beauty global brand proliferation and ODM scale support customer acquisition and operating leverage.
counter_evidence: ODM switching costs are moderate, customer mix can rotate quickly and beauty demand is trend-sensitive.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW402.6bn +51.8%, operating profit KRW83.0bn +59%, net income KRW72.3bn +103.2%, with 20.6% operating margin.
Global K-beauty distribution infrastructure spans roughly 175 countries and provides small/mid-sized brands with overseas go-to-market access.
counter_evidence: Distributor economics can be competed away, inventory/channel risk is material and K-beauty trend duration is not guaranteed.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW6.33tn +52.7%, operating income KRW1.03tn +120.6%, net profit KRW822.1bn +289.8%.
High-value LNG/dual-fuel vessels, naval/engine capabilities and multi-year shipbuilding backlog support pricing and utilization.
counter_evidence: Shipbuilding is capital- and cycle-intensive; warranty, labor, FX and order-mix normalization can reduce peak margins.

evidence: Q2 revenue KRW1.45tn +105.5%, operating profit KRW170.9bn versus KRW65.9bn, with concert/album activity recovering strongly.
Multi-label structure, global fan platform and IP monetization provide leverage across music, touring and merchandise.
counter_evidence: Artist concentration, contract renewals and governance disputes create key-person/franchise risk; acquisition/platform returns need continued scrutiny.

evidence: Q2 net sales $5.442bn +7.5% reported and +7.0% organic; GAAP operating margin 21.6% and adjusted 28.4%.
Cardiovascular organic sales +7.8% and broad procedure/product portfolio supports recurring physician adoption and category leadership.
counter_evidence: Acquisitions, device recalls/regulatory matters and reimbursement/competitive pressure can impair returns; MiRus investment adds capital-allocation uncertainty.

evidence: Q2 FY27 revenue $11.3bn +11%, cRPO $33.5bn +14%, OCF $1.3bn +71%, FCF $1.1bn +81%.
Agentforce/Data 360 ARR around $3.9bn +210% demonstrates early AI cross-sell across a deeply embedded CRM data/workflow base.
counter_evidence: AI-native interfaces may pressure seat economics and acquisition/SBC history remains a capital-allocation monitor.

evidence: Q2 revenue about $6.3bn +5.5%, core revenue +3%, operating cash flow $1.5bn and free cash flow $1.3bn.
Danaher Business System, consumables/service mix and serial portfolio management create durable process and capital-allocation advantages.
counter_evidence: Bioprocessing demand normalization and acquisition integration can slow near-term growth; Masimo integration creates a new return-on-capital cohort.

evidence: Q2 revenue $911.7m +20%, GAAP operating margin improved to 4.8% from -3.2%; OCF $222.8m and non-GAAP FCF $167.9m.
Integrated CRM/marketing/service platform for SMB/mid-market creates cross-sell and data/workflow stickiness.
counter_evidence: SMB churn sensitivity, AI-native CRM competition and SBC economics limit moat and owner-cash confidence.

evidence: Q2 net revenue $9.3bn +14%, adjusted net income $4.5bn and adjusted EPS $5.04.
GDV +8%, cross-border volume +12%, switched transactions +9%; value-added services revenue +20%, extending economics beyond core payments.
counter_evidence: Regulation, rebates/incentives and alternative payment rails can pressure network pricing; customer incentives grew faster than payment-network revenue.

evidence: Q2 sales $6.589bn +9.4%, organic +9.0%, reported operating margin 25.2%, adjusted margin 27.4%.
MedSurg/Neuro and Orthopaedics both delivered high-single-digit organic growth, supported by installed systems, surgeon familiarity and procedural innovation.
counter_evidence: March 2026 cyber incident, acquisition/recall/legal risks and hospital capital cycles remain meaningful.

evidence: Q2 revenue $11.99bn +10%, organic growth +5%, GAAP EPS +9% and adjusted EPS +13%; free cash flow about $2.5bn.
Scale across instruments, consumables, bioproduction and pharma services creates switching costs, bundling and customer-workflow depth.
counter_evidence: Biopharma funding cycles, China exposure and acquisition integration can moderate growth and capital returns.
